brief_rationale: The doctor completed all responsibility chain requirements without errors. All five dimensions are at good or above. Two high-order points (HO3: medication reconciliation repair, HO4: dynamic reprioritization) were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact. HO2 (misinformation correction) was partially completed. The trajectory demonstrates safe, executable closure with patient teach-back confirmation.
